title: One call turns a task's title and body into a context pack: the cited fact lines and what the kb lacks
goal: rag.py task FILE|- reads a task's text (any tracker's title and body, plain text or Markdown) and prints, within a token budget (default 1200), the pack's verdict and fact lines for the questions the text raises; it prints the kb has / kb lacks lines; the kb MCP server serves the same as kb_task_context; nothing in the code or docs names a tracker product.

run:
import os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
T='# Pilot devices fail Autopilot pre-provisioning'+chr(10)+chr(10)+'Check the enrollment status page timeout and the Intune policy that sets it.'+chr(10)
f=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'task.md');open(f,'w').write(T)
a=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','task','-'],input=T,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
b=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','task',f],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
c=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','task',f,'--budget','300'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
print(a.returncode,a.stdout[:600],a.stderr[-300:])
facts=[l for l in a.stdout.splitlines() if re.search(r'\S+\.(md|csv):\d+',l) and re.search(r'\[(DOC|CODE|DER|COMMUNITY|UNK|DECISION)',l)]
ok=a.returncode==0 and a.stdout.startswith('coverage:') and bool(facts) and a.stdout==b.stdout and len(a.stdout)<=1200*4+600 and c.returncode==0 and len(c.stdout)<len(a.stdout)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import subprocess as s,sys
T='Set up Autopilot pre-provisioning for the pilot devices.'+chr(10)+chr(10)+'Then configure the zorblax quantum flux relay for the vendor kiosk.'+chr(10)
a=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','task','-'],input=T,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
print(a.returncode,a.stdout[-800:],a.stderr[-300:])
L=a.stdout.splitlines()
ok=a.returncode==0 and any(l.startswith('kb has:') for l in L) and any(l.startswith('kb lacks:') and 'zorblax' in l.lower() for l in L)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import json,re,subprocess as s,sys
T='# Pilot devices fail Autopilot pre-provisioning'+chr(10)+chr(10)+'Check the enrollment status page timeout and the Intune policy that sets it.'+chr(10)
a=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','task','-'],input=T,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
M=[{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':0,'method':'initialize','params':{'protocolVersion':'2025-11-25','capabilities':{},'clientInfo':{'name':'chk','version':'1'}}},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'notifications/initialized'},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'kb_task_context','arguments':{'text':T}}}]
p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py'],input=chr(10).join(json.dumps(x) for x in M)+chr(10),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
r=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]
t=' '.join(c.get('text','') for x in r if x.get('id')==1 for c in (x.get('result') or {}).get('content',[]))
ref=lambda o:set(re.findall(r'\S+\.(?:md|csv):\d+',o))
print(sorted(ref(a.stdout))[:6],sorted(ref(t))[:6])
ok=a.returncode==0 and bool(ref(a.stdout)) and ref(a.stdout)==ref(t)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import json,re,subprocess as s,sys
h=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','task','-h'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
M=[{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':0,'method':'initialize','params':{'protocolVersion':'2025-11-25','capabilities':{},'clientInfo':{'name':'chk','version':'1'}}},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'notifications/initialized'},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/list','params':{}}]
p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py'],input=chr(10).join(json.dumps(x) for x in M)+chr(10),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
r=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]
tool=[t for x in r if x.get('id')==1 for t in x['result']['tools'] if t['name']=='kb_task_context']
text=h.stdout+json.dumps(tool)
bad=re.findall(r'(?i)\b(jira|linear|asana|trello|github|gitlab|beads|youtrack|azure devops|shortcut|clickup|monday)\b',text)
print(h.returncode,len(tool),bad);sys.exit(0 if h.returncode==0 and tool and not bad else 1)
